strict.description: Default profile. Tight budgets для нового кода + ratchet через baseline. Architecturally-структурные surfaces легализованы через pathOverrides ниже (Mongo adapter layer, REST controllers, Domain primary ctors, MCP tool surfaces) — каждый с rationale, привязанным к intent или ADR.

pathOverrides._comment: intent:4b43b94c4a194a30b8ddb99c67643d7f — NSwag-generated REST controllers compose one abstract override per route, so ctor surface grows linearly with endpoint count.
MCP tool surfaces ship as one class per tool group and inject the underlying handler/service deps; ctor fan-out is by design (см. specs/AGENTS.local.md MCP tools).

intent:aa5b39b430c54685a08f475d3be167b9 — Mongo adapter layer wraps Builders<TDoc> chains + atomic read-then-update sequences. Type/method budgets stay at legacy thresholds; per-method CC ≤25 still catches real complexity. Same precedent as REST controllers above.
MCP keep-alive middleware embeds a SerializingWriteStream nested type that mirrors the Stream public API.
Stdio MCP proxy log surface mirrors LoggerMessage source-generated partial methods.

ADR-0025 — Throne.Domain нормативно ведётся в rich-DDD стиле (агрегат сам несёт public static Create/Restore, инварианты инлайн, state-переходы инстансными методами). Lift LOC/member/CC/fan-out лимитов снимает давление харнеса к расщеплению на *Factory/*Guards/*Mutator. Запреты охраняются ADR + ревью и NetArchTest «no internal set в Throne.Domain». Поглощает прежние Domain-override (constructorMaxDependencies:10) и DreamSession-override (typeMaxPublicMembers:20).
Application handlers orchestrate UoW + domain calls + persistence; HandleAsync commonly covers a single logical transaction.
Pin/Move handlers ship as one file per command group (ADR-0007), with multiple AddPin/RemovePin/MovePin handlers in the same file.
DI composition root concentrates Application service registrations.
ErrorCodes is a typed registry of wire-string constants; public surface = error catalogue size.
Mongo POCO documents fan out [BsonElement] properties; public surface = persisted field count.
MongoCollectionNames is a constant registry per Mongo collection (ADR-0009/0019/0021/0022).
Test fixtures + WebApplicationFactory orchestration co-locate setup with cases; CA1502 globs cover analyzer side, here we relax LOC/CC for the test type itself.

legacy.description: Сохранён на случай emergency rollback. Default profile — strict.

pathOverrides._comment: REST-контроллеры композируют по одному endpoint-классу на route. С 10+ routes ctor неизбежно держит >8 deps; это арифметика surface area NSwag-generated абстрактного базового класса, а не code smell. Per-method limits остаются.
